indexes._comment: Powers listMatchesByRole + subscribeMatchesByRole (sub-issue #99 of #20). The Matches tab (#21) renders matches scoped to the current Role, ordered by final_score desc. Composite on (owner_uid, role_id, final_score desc). owner_uid is part of every match query for cross-tenant safety; role_id is the per-Role scope; final_score desc is the rank order shown to the user. Without this index, Firestore rejects the orderBy + multiple where clauses combination.

Powers the experienceUnits fetch in the validateAsset orchestrator (functions/src/validation/validate.ts). Each asset's claims are traced against the owner's user-approved Units, fetched in chunks via .where("owner_uid", "==").where("user_approved", "==").where("id", "in", chunk). The two equality filters plus the `in` on `id` require this composite index; without it Firestore rejects the query at runtime with 'no matching composite index found', breaking validateAsset for any asset whose bullets reference approved Units.
